title: Representation in District-Based Elections
abstract: arXiv:2602.12910v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: District-based elections must reconcile two objectives: representing each district's electorate and matching the statewide delegation to parties' vote shares. We study seat allocation rules when these objectives conflict. The optimal rules, characterized by a cutoff, form a family ranging from first-past-the-post to proportional representation as the weight on statewide representation increases. Along this path, gaining further seats through gerrymandering becomes increasingly difficult. The characterization yields a measure of the robustness of first-past-the-post to statewide representation concerns, which we compare with established electoral diagnostics. In U.S. House elections from 2002 to 2024, we find that maps drawn by single-party legislatures perform worse than those produced by courts or non-partisan commissions. The efficiency gap, a common measure of partisan gerrymandering, is more strongly associated with litigated map

translated_title: 基于选区制选举中的代表性
translated_abstract: 基于选区的选举必须调和两个目标：代表每个选区的选民，以及使全州代表团与各政党的得票份额相匹配。我们研究了当这两个目标发生冲突时的席位分配规则。最优规则以一个临界值为特征，随着赋予全州代表性权重的增加，构成了一个从简单多数制（first-past-the-post）到比例代表制的规则家族。沿着这一路径，通过不公正的选区划分获取更多席位变得越来越困难。这一刻画结果给出了一种衡量简单多数制对全州代表性问题稳健性的指标，我们将其与已有的选举诊断方法进行了比较。在2002年至2024年的美国众议院选举中，我们发现由单一政党控制的立法机构绘制的选区地图表现劣于由法院或无党派委员会绘制的地图。效率差距——一种常用的党派不公正选区划分衡量标准——与涉诉地图的关联更强。
tldr: 本文刻画了选区制选举中当选区代表性与全州代表性目标冲突时的最优席位分配规则——该规则构成从简单多数制到比例代表制的连续家族，并应用于2002-2024年美国众议院选举数据，发现单一政党立法机构绘制的选区地图表现劣于法院或无党派委员会绘制的地图。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes optimal seat allocation rules in district-based elections when district and statewide representation objectives conflict—forming a family from first-past-the-post to proportional representation—and shows, using U.S. House elections from 2002 to 2024, that maps drawn by single-party legislatures perform worse than those produced by courts or non-partisan commissions.
